notes: • System Monitor now opens only for signed-in superadmins. Anyone else sees a short locked page with a Sign in or Switch account button, and the applet is hidden from the launcher and store until your account is confirmed.

• System Monitor now opens only for signed-in superadmins. Anyone else sees a short locked page with a Sign in or Switch account button, and the applet is hidden from the launcher and store until your account is confirmed.

• Docs: real pages. A document now opens on separate sheets of paper you type straight onto. Page setup (the ruler button in the toolbar) picks the paper (Letter, A4 or Legal), portrait or landscape, and the four margins in inches or centimetres; you can also drag the left and right margin markers on the ruler above the page. Insert page break (or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter) starts a new page; Backspace removes it. The setup and breaks are saved inside the document, and Word (.docx) files keep them. Older copies of the app still open these documents (as one continuous page). Print and the new Export PDF button (beside Print) use the document's own paper, margins, font sizes and page breaks; from the Page view, each printed page holds the same lines as the page on screen.

• Docs: type or pick an exact font size in points (8 to 72, or any number from 6 to 144, halves allowed) instead of Small, Large and Huge; your existing text keeps its look until you change it. Printed pages now match the screen sizes.

• Docs: type or pick an exact font size in points (8 to 72, or any number from 6 to 144, halves allowed) instead of Small, Large and Huge; your existing text keeps its look until you change it. Printed pages now match the screen sizes.

• Music Bench (was musicmaker): a 100-day plan opens first — a 10 by 10 board, a short lesson and one drill a day, your own pace or one day per date, and a streak that forgives one missed day. A keyboard under the music lights the keys with finger numbers where the fingering is certain; a volume control sits next to the speaker; the screen stays on while music is open (switch in View).
• Shared boards: fixed items going missing after many changes arrive at once or while the app was closed. If a board already shows stray items at its top level, press Refresh now once.

• Dispatch: each panel has a Sort and folders button next to +. Put folders at the top, at the bottom or mixed in, pick the sort order (manual, title, created, last edited, owner), or open the filter.

• bubliea: Suite now has one bubliea tool (New bubliea) that opens to Bubbles, Outline or Diagram of the same bubbles; your existing boards are unchanged. The older Ideas app is retired — people who have it keep it.
